channel.description: Latest articles from The Colorado Sun (coloradosun.com)

item.title: Contract Grant Writer
item.description: The Colorado Sun seeks a contract grant writer to join our growth-oriented development team, supporting our strategic mission through targeted grant-funded revenue.

item.title: $10 stadium hot dog in Colorado lives on as effort to prevent high “captive audience” pricing meets demise
item.description: House Bill 1012 was rejected Tuesday during its first hearing at the Colorado Capitol. It faced big opposition from the business community.

item.title: Littwin: Dispatch from the front: Still no word on why we went to war in Iran
item.description: Columnist Mike Littwin writes that even after four days, we still don't know why we went to war in Iran. And folks on the home front are not happy about it.

item.title: Tension over hunting animals for their fur prompts higher security at Colorado Parks and Wildlife meeting
item.description: A CPW official cited large turnout and “detailed information about public testimony” as reasons for checking people for weapons at the door at the Wednesday meeting

item.title: How “conservation pool” water management could provide a way forward for Colorado River users
item.description: Some experts say, with negotiations at an impasse, this new concept could encourage less water use. Others say not so fast.

item.title: Colorado entrepreneurs build a holding company for employee-owned outdoor recreation businesses
item.description: The Outdoor Rec Collective plans a diverse collection of employee-owned outdoor companies to help owners sustain their brands while delivering higher wages

item.title: What’s the future for solar in Colorado? Go it alone but find a federal friend, experts say.
item.description: At renewable energy convention, mood is subdued but not despairing for developers of green projects

item.title: Do you use cash advance apps like MoneyLion, EarnIn or Brigit? We want to hear from you.
item.description: The Colorado Sun wants to talk to you about your experience using apps to access money before your paycheck arrives

item.title: Not a single Democrat in the Colorado legislature says Jared Polis should reduce Tina Peters’ sentence. He appears set to do it anyway.
item.description: The Colorado Sun asked every Democrat in the legislature Wednesday whether Polis should offer Peters clemency after the governor all but said on social media Tuesday that he plans to do so

item.title: Measles cases in Broomfield now an outbreak, unvaccinated students at two schools sent home for 21 days
item.description: Latest case involves a child connected to Broomfield Heights Middle School
